methods.steps: Open the AVIF, choose File > Export As and give the file a name ending in .eps; set the width, height, offsets, Encapsulated PostScript and preview in the EPS dialog.
methods.limits: Raster artwork stays raster; the dialog sets the placed size.
methods.verification: Fetched and checked: the cited pages show the steps, options and input format named here.

methods.steps: Run magick texture.bmp texture.tga.
methods.limits: Reads and writes both per the format table.
methods.verification: Fetched and checked: the cited pages show the steps, options and input format named here.

methods.steps: Open the BMP, File > Export As a name ending in .tga; RLE checkbox and Origin choice.
methods.limits: The origin setting changes how pixels are stored, not how the image looks.
methods.verification: Fetched and checked: the cited pages show the steps, options and input format named here.

methods.steps: Run magick bitmap.bmp -compress LZW bitmap.tif.
methods.limits: LZW is lossless.
methods.verification: Fetched and checked: the cited pages show the steps, options and input format named here.

methods.steps: Open the BMP, File > Export As a name ending in .tif; choose the TIFF compression.
methods.limits: The dialog lists None, LZW, Pack Bits, Deflate and JPEG.
methods.verification: Fetched and checked: the cited pages show the steps, options and input format named here.

methods.steps: Run magick panel.bmp -define webp:lossless=true panel.webp.
methods.limits: Lossless output.
methods.verification: Fetched and checked: the cited pages show the steps, options and input format named here.

methods.steps: Open the BMP, File > Export As a name ending in .webp; Lossless checkbox.
methods.limits: Lossless turns off Image quality and Alpha quality.
methods.verification: Fetched and checked: the cited pages show the steps, options and input format named here.

methods.steps: Run magick panel.bmp panel-stage.png, then cwebp -q 85 panel-stage.png -o panel.webp.
methods.limits: The -q value runs from 0 to 100.
methods.verification: Fetched and checked: the cited pages show the steps, options and input format named here.

methods.steps: Run magick mark.bmp -threshold 50% mark.xbm.
methods.limits: The picture ends up black and white.
methods.verification: Fetched and checked: the cited pages show the steps, options and input format named here.

methods.steps: Open the BMP, File > Export As a name ending in .xbm.
methods.limits: Needs 8 bits per channel; the dialog offers prefix, hot spot, comment and mask file.
methods.verification: Fetched and checked: the cited pages show the steps, options and input format named here.

methods.steps: Image.open the BMP, convert("1"), save with a .xbm name.
methods.limits: Pillow reads and writes X bitmap in mode 1; conversion dithers by default.
methods.verification: Fetched and checked: the cited pages show the steps, options and input format named here.

methods.steps: Export a TIFF from darktable (target storage file on disk, file format TIFF); open it in GIMP and export to a name ending in .pdf.
methods.limits: The PDF holds a rendered picture, not RAW data.
methods.verification: Fetched and checked: the cited pages show the steps, options and input format named here.

methods.steps: DPP File > Batch process, TIFF, Execute; then run magick developed.tif proof.pdf.
methods.limits: ImageMagick PDF support requires Ghostscript.
methods.verification: Fetched and checked: the cited pages show the steps, options and input format named here.

methods.steps: Select the CR3 images; File > Batch process; settings with TIFF; Execute.
methods.limits: Check that your camera model is supported.
methods.verification: Fetched and checked: the cited pages show the steps, options and input format named here.

methods.steps: Export module: target storage file on disk, file format TIFF; check bit depth and profile; export.
methods.limits: Needs a supported CR3 camera and decoding dependencies.
methods.verification: Fetched and checked: the cited pages show the steps, options and input format named here.

methods.steps: Run magick older-canon.crw older-canon.jpg.
methods.limits: Format table lists CRW as read-only.
methods.verification: Fetched and checked: the cited pages show the steps, options and input format named here.

methods.steps: Select the CRW; File > Batch process; settings with JPEG; Execute.
methods.limits: Supported cameras only.
methods.verification: Fetched and checked: the cited pages show the steps, options and input format named here.

methods.steps: Run magick pointer.cur pointer.gif.
methods.limits: A GIF carries no hotspot.
methods.verification: Fetched and checked: the cited pages show the steps, options and input format named here.

methods.steps: Open the CUR with Image.open and save with a .gif file name.
methods.limits: CUR is read-only; decoder reads the largest cursor; animated cursors are not supported.
methods.verification: Fetched and checked: the cited pages show the steps, options and input format named here.

methods.steps: Run magick pointer.cur pointer.png; open the PNG in GIMP; export as GIF.
methods.limits: GIMP exports a maximum of 256 colors.
methods.verification: Fetched and checked: the cited pages show the steps, options and input format named here.

methods.steps: Open the DOCX in Writer; File > Export As > Export as PDF; run pdf2svg writer-copy.pdf writer-page.svg 1.
methods.limits: pdf2svg takes a page number or all; DOCX import can change layout.
methods.verification: Fetched and checked: the cited pages show the steps, options and input format named here.
